theorems.name: Submission.p05_ftzw_tensor_relation_kernel_a5b449214a
theorems.statement: ∀ {D : Type*} [CommRing D] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module D M] {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module D P], let b : M → P → FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) := fun u z => FreeAbelianGroup.of (u, z); (FreeAbelianGroup.lift (fun x : M × P => TensorProduct.tmul D x.1 x.2)).ker = AddSubgroup.closure {r : FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) | (∃ z : P, r = b 0 z) ∨ (∃ u : M, r = b u 0) ∨ (∃ (u v : M) (z : P), r = b (u + v) z - b u z - b v z) ∨ (∃ (u : M) (z w : P), r = b u (z + w) - b u z - b u w) ∨ (∃ (d : D) (u : M) (z : P), r = b (d • u) z - b u (d • z))}
